args.title: Minpentai Quarter-Final Match – Six Panel Comic

shots.description: Zei steps into the elevator pod, heading to the arena.

lines.text: Zei walked into one of the elevator pods on the wall. The door closed, and he could feel the elevator start to descend.

shots.description: The arena opens to a massive audience.

lines.text: A quarter minute later, the elevator door opened, exposing a giant room with over a thousand people watching.

shots.description: Bai confronts Zei, taunting him before the match.

lines.text: Bai walked up closer, and put her hand on Zei's shoulder. "So, you afraid of me, Zei? You know I enjoy making you feel afraid. Taking your excitement about getting some prize money to buy a compute box for your mom, and snatching it all away, getting myself a vacation in the beautiful south islands of Redshire. I should send you pictures."

shots.description: Security drones scan Zei for cheating devices.

lines.text: Drones about the size of a hand device buzzed as they flew around Zei, scanning for any kind of equipment that could be used for cheating.
A loud automated voice, once again stern, announced: "MU GU GEI FA". Starting in fifty ticks.

Zei calmed down and tried to put his stress behind him, and rehearsed once again in his head the tactics. Walls, gliders, rocks, techniques for extracting usable negentropy from rocks, sideways attacks.
